title: Cologne Police Seize Robot Used in First Humanoid Sexual Assault
summary:
A 16 year old girl in Germany was groped by a 4 foot tall machine in a public area. Police in Cologne confiscated the robot from the boot of a Volkswagen along with two mobile phones, after the device made lewd thrusting motions at the girl and other women. The robot was allegedly operated by its 16 year old owner and a 19 year old companion, who livestreamed the incident on social media for views.

Investigators are currently determining whether the machine was operated via remote control or followed pre-programmed movements. While both teenagers associated with the device remain under investigation by Cologne authorities, neither has been charged with a crime at this time.

A robot sexually harassed a 16-year-old girl in Cologne

According to Bild, a robot approached a 16-year-old girl in central Cologne and began making lewd movements.

The robot was allegedly being operated by its 16-year-old owner and his 19-year-old friend. They may have filmed the incident and streamed it on social media.

Police found the robot in a car trunk and seized it along with two phones. Investigators are now trying to establish how the device was controlled and whether its actions were intentional.
